How to play

  1. Pick a card from your hand, then tap a glowing row. That's the only way to play.
  2. Units add their power to your row. Your total is the sum of your three rows: Clash, Tech, Spirit.
  3. Win a round by having the higher total when both fighters Pass. Win 2 rounds to win the duel (each round lost costs a gem).
  4. Cards are not refilled much: you draw only 1 card per new round. Passing early to save cards is a real tactic.
  5. Drain cards lower enemy units (never below 1; heroes are immune). Break destroys the strongest units in a facing row of 10+.
  6. Bond multiplies copies in a row, Muster brings all copies, Morale +1 to the row, Rally doubles the row, Revive replays a fallen unit, Bluff goes to the enemy side but draws you 2.
  7. Your gold Leader card is in your hand from the start: one use per match.
  8. Tap during a move cut-in to skip it.
